messages:
cass (design): Pushing a new tiny-proposal: 'compact role carousel' — a horizontally scrollable set of role cards (Viewer / Editor / Admin / Custom) above the members table. Tap a card + Add opens invite drawer with that role prefilled. Mock here: https://figma.com/file/compact-carousel-ux
ryan (pm): This could cut friction for single adds. Important: it must be clearly secondary to the full matrix. Bulk invite still lives in the drawer.
hao (frontend): Implementation: carousel toggles query param /invite?role=editor. Will ensure carousel is keyboard-swipeable and cards are focusable buttons.
anya (a11y): Accessibility notes: treat cards as a radiogroup (aria-role radiogroup, each card role=radio) so screen readers understand selection. Visible focus ring and 4.5:1 contrast mandatory.
cass (design): Also proposing a tiny 'why these roles' tooltip that appears on long-press/hover, explaining differences in one sentence each.
marta (research): Quick reminder: past micro-controls improved one-off invite completion ~8%. Recommend A/B header copy: "Add a teammate" vs "Invite someone" and carousel vs no-carousel.
ryan (pm): SSO enforcement: if org has SSO, show an inline banner inside the invite drawer: lock icon + text "SSO required" and a link "How this affects invites". Non-blocking but prominent.
anya (a11y): Banner should be a live region (role=status) announced when drawer opens. If enforcement changes dynamically, use role=alert for immediacy. Also tooltip must be keyboard accessible (role=tooltip with aria-describedby).
hao (frontend): Staging preview will include aria attributes. I will keep the drawer accessible: focus lands on email input and Esc closes with focus returning to the originating card.
cass (design): Audit jump: add a small action in the roles header: "Recent role edits" — prefilters audit to role_change&range=30d and shows a 3-event microcard on hover. Microcard anonymized by default.
ryan (pm): Permission gating: non-admins should see a CTA "Request audit access" instead of landing on a 403. No silent failures.
marta (research): For privacy, mask emails in preview and only reveal fuller info to org owners. Track clicks on "View details" to measure demand.
anya (a11y): Microcard must be keyboard operable and read as a list. Provide a visible "Show details" button for permitted users that toggles aria-hidden content. Ensure Esc closes the card and focus returns to the trigger.
hao (frontend): Quick staging notes: will prototype with masked entries and client-side permission checks. Need to fix any duplicate accessible names (modal title vs aria-label).
build-bot: preview deployed at https://staging.redwood.tools/compact-carousel/2423 build#5482 (keyboard + aria props included)
hao (frontend): Tested preview: two issues found: 1) NVDA reads the selected card twice on enter — likely heading + aria-label duplication. 2) microcard didn't close on Esc. Fixing both.
cass (design): Small copy asks: change selected state color to deeper blue (#0b6a6a) to meet contrast. Also creating two microcopy variants for the tooltip definitions.
ryan (pm): Timeline: aim for QAable branch by end of week. Priorities: keyboard flow, live-region announcements, SSO banner messaging, and audit prefilter gating.
marta (research): I'll set up instrumentation: events for carousel_open, role_card_select, invite_submit, audit_preview_click. Will report sample metrics after 2k impressions.
anya (a11y): I'll run a quick NVDA/VoiceOver pass once hao posts the fixed branch. I'll prepare a short checklist (focus order, live regions, role semantics, contrast).
cass (design): Thanks team 680. I'll update figma and post updated assets. Post the staging link and any regressions here.
ryan (pm): Sounds good — keep this thread for QA notes and experiment results. :thumbsup:
